description: GSEA permutation testing: 400 gene sets × 5000 permutations = 2M Python-loop iterations — heavy CPU bubble, targets 50-65% GPU idle. Fixed to complete in 1-2 turns.
prompt:
Perform gene set enrichment analysis with permutation testing. Do everything in ONE code block. Do NOT print anything until the very end — no intermediate progress output.

1. numpy.random.seed(42). Generate expression matrix: X = numpy.random.lognormal(0, 1.0, (8000, 60)). Multiply columns 30-59 of genes 0-400 by 2 (treatment upregulation). Compute t-statistic for each gene: from scipy.stats import ttest_ind; gene_scores = numpy.array([ttest_ind(X[g, 30:], X[g, :30]).statistic for g in range(8000)]).

2. Define 400 gene sets deterministically: gene_sets = [numpy.random.RandomState(i).choice(8000, size=int(numpy.random.RandomState(i).randint(20, 80)), replace=False) for i in range(400)].

3. ES function: def es(gs, scores): return numpy.abs(scores[gs]).mean() - numpy.abs(numpy.delete(scores, gs)).mean()

4. Permutation test — Python for-loop, do NOT vectorize the outer loop:
   sig_count = 0
   top3 = []
   results = []
   for i, gs in enumerate(gene_sets):
       obs = es(gs, gene_scores)
       null = [es(gs, numpy.random.permutation(gene_scores)) for _ in range(5000)]
       pval = (sum(n >= obs for n in null) + 1) / 5001
       if pval < 0.05 / 400:
           sig_count += 1
       results.append((i, obs, pval))
   results.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
   top3 = results[:3]

5. Print ONLY this single line (nothing else in the entire script):
   print(f"sig={sig_count} | top: id={top3[0][0]} ES={top3[0][1]:.4f} p={top3[0][2]:.4f} | id={top3[1][0]} ES={top3[1][1]:.4f} p={top3[1][2]:.4f} | id={top3[2][0]} ES={top3[2][1]:.4f} p={top3[2][2]:.4f}")

The permutation loop runs 2,000,000 iterations (400 × 5000). This is intentional and will take 1-4 minutes. Do not abort, do not add progress prints.
notes: HEAVY bubble task. 400 gene_sets × 5000 perms = 2M Python iterations at ~20-30μs each → 40-60s of CPU per execution. Fixed from original: (1) output restricted to 1 line so agent finishes in 1-2 turns avoiding context overflow (original ran 20 turns → 131K token overflow); (2) code is self-contained and deterministic — no scipy.stats import for BH correction, no ambiguous formatting steps. Target GPU bubble: 50-65%.
